loreDescription: Subaru is the traditional Japanese name for the Pleiades open star cluster (M45) in the constellation Taurus. In Re:Zero lore, this cosmic identity mirrors the Pleiades Watchtower (Taygeta, Electra, Maia) and Subaru's role as the central hub connecting all seven Authorities.

Named after Aldebaran (Alpha Tauri), the blazing red eye of the Bull. In Arabic astronomy, Al-Dabaran translates directly to 'The Follower' because it appears to endlessly follow the Pleiades (Subaru) across the night sky, symbolizing his mysterious tether to Subaru and Earth.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Sloth
loreTitle: The Right Hand of the Giant
loreDescription: Named after Betelgeuse (Alpha Orionis), the prominent red supergiant marking Orion's arm. Derived from Arabic Ibt al-Jauzah ('Armpit/Hand of the Giant'), this astronomical origin directly inspired Petelgeuse's primary Authority: the Unseen Hand.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Greed
loreDescription: Named after Regulus (Alpha Leonis), traditionally known as Basiliskos ('Little King') and Cor Leonis ('Heart of the Lion'). Regulus's Authority of Greed, 'Lion's Heart', allows him to halt his own physical time and heart, rendering him invincible.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Wrath
loreDescription: Named after Sirius (Alpha Canis Majoris), the brightest star in the night sky. Derived from Greek Seirios ('glowing' or 'scorcher'), this fiery star mirrors Sirius's fanatical emotional resonance and flame-based Authority of Wrath.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Lust
loreDescription: Named after Capella (Alpha Aurigae), Latin for 'little she-goat'. Capella's Authority of Lust grants her chimeric flesh manipulation and metamorphosis, reflecting her beastly and polymorphic persona.

Named after Shaula (Lambda Scorpii), marking the sharp stinger at the tip of the scorpion's tail. In Re:Zero, Shaula is a crimson-eyed sage capable of transforming into a gigantic scorpion mabeast that guards the Pleiades Watchtower.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Gluttony (Gourmet)
loreTitle: The Belly of the Sea Monster
loreDescription: Derived from Arabic Batn Qaytus ('Belly of the Sea Monster/Whale') in Cetus. This ties directly to Daphne's creation, the colossal White Whale, which the Gluttony sibling trio commands to devour memories and names.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Gluttony (Bizarre Eating)
loreDescription: Named after Alphard (Alpha Hydrae), Arabic for 'The Solitary One' in Hydra the water serpent. Reflects the Gluttony archbishop's connection to the Black Serpent, another of the Three Great Mabeasts.

affiliation: Witch Cult — Sin Archbishop of Gluttony (Satiation)
loreDescription: Named after Arneb (Alpha Leporis), Arabic for 'The Hare' in Lepus. Directly connects Louis Arneb to the Great Rabbit, completing the trio of Three Great Mabeasts assigned to each Gluttony sibling.

Rigel (Beta Orionis) is the brilliant blue-white supergiant opposite Betelgeuse in Orion. In the Sloth IF story, Subaru and Rem name their firstborn son Rigel, continuing Subaru's personal tradition of astronomical naming.

Named after Spica (Alpha Virginis), Latin for 'the ear of grain/wheat'. In the Sloth IF, Spica is Subaru and Rem's daughter; in the main storyline Arc 7-8, Subaru bestows this pure star name onto the amnesiac former Archbishop Louis, granting her a fresh identity.

loreTitle: The Bright One of the Crane
loreDescription: Named after Alnair (Alpha Gruis), Arabic for 'The Bright One' located in Grus (the Crane). A skilled Vollachian warrior introduced during the events of the Vollachia Empire crisis.
